title: After a lot of trial and error, I finally have a ratings system that ...
transcript: Some of you may have noticed that I have soft launched a theater rating system for all of my official reviews. Now, I've toyed around with other rating systems in the past, like star ratings or number ratings, but they never quite worked for me and I've been looking for something that was a little bit less rigid but still allowed you, the audience, to know which shows I really recommend. So instead I've opted for my own version of a Critic’s Pick system. But instead of just having Critic’s Pick, I actually have two different categorizations. The first is a Broadway Ben recommendation. These are shows that I really enjoy. If you're doing a trip to New York, they should definitely be on your radar. If you wanna put it in terms of stars, these are gonna be your three and four star shows. The second is a Broadway Ben must see. This is if you're doing a trip to New York, you only have a few spots. You wanna know which shows to prioritize. These are the shows that I personally enjoyed the most and would recommend prioritizing. In a star system, these would be your five star shows. And of course, if there's a show I didn't care for as much, I'm just going to opt to not give that a rating. And if you wanna see if a show got a particular designation, it is always going to be at the very end of the video. Of course, If you just wanna know the rating, you can skip to the end and see what rating I gave it. But I did put it back there intentionally because I do want you to watch the full review. Not just for my own retention rate, but because theater criticism is so much more than just “show good” or “show bad.” There is a lot of nuance that I try to jam into my very short, less than three minute reviews. And my hope is that by watching my reviews, you'll get a sense of not just if I liked it, but if you yourself will like it. Because not every show that I like is gonna be for you, and not every show that you like is gonna be for me. And that's okay. That's the beauty of theater. But still, I know a lot of people watch my content specifically for recommendations and what to see while they're in New York. So hopefully this new rating system is a good compromise. Where I'm still giving you a quick, high level way to know how I felt about a show while not having to assign it a specific numerical value, framing it as a personal recommendation rather than an objective measurement of quality.
classificationReason: Creator is explaining their personal theater ratings system (Broadway Ben recommendation vs. must-see), not reviewing any specific show. No production is being discussed.
